name: example-trace-multibatch
goal: Demonstrate a small multi-batch run whose retained manifest proves event and branch-context lineage.

sharedContext.summary: Use this plan as the smallest tracked multi-batch trace fixture. The root analyst task fans out into two downstream read-only tasks so retained events show multiple ready batches and explicit branch lineage.
constraints: Do not edit TODO.md, ai/state files, ai/log files, or ai/indexes.

tasks.title: Inspect the retained trace contract
tasks.prompt: Read the orchestrator docs and script. Summarize what retained run manifests currently expose about event traces and branch lineage.

tasks.title: Inspect the retained status surface
tasks.prompt: Use the upstream trace-contract summary as context. Summarize what the retained status command should surface for operators who need compact run lineage.

tasks.title: Inspect the retained evaluation surface
tasks.prompt: Use the upstream trace-contract summary as context. Summarize what an operator-focused run evaluator should flag about orchestration quality.
